release: Name Resolution Result Batching & Thumbnail Transport Telemetry
name: Name Resolution Result Batching & Thumbnail Transport Telemetry
changes: Batches rapid All Posts name-resolution result updates so resolver batches do not each force a full article/package DOM rebuild.
Returns per-request image-thumbnail server elapsed time and records paired browser HTTP, server, and transport-gap telemetry for the same request.
Records current and peak image-thumbnail endpoint concurrency by browsing mode to reveal whether local HTTP dispatch is constraining delivery.
Preserves v3.6.62 progressive header reuse, v3.6.63 status-render coalescing, 800-header bounds, concurrency budgets, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Name-resolution start/retry/finish state changes use targeted DOM updates; full list/package renders remain result-driven.
Thumbnail queue/HTTP/post/recovery timing stays passive and bounded; backend failure-code classification uses existing preview_error_info semantics.
v3.6.62 progressive first-paint seed reuse and 800/800/1000 header tuning remain unchanged.
All carried behavioral guards remain mandatory; SAB 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema 3 remain unchanged.
release_name: Name Resolution Result Batching & Thumbnail Transport Telemetry
